tasks.title: Setup shadcn/ui CLI and Initial Configuration
tasks.description: Install shadcn/ui CLI and initialize the project with proper configuration
tasks.details: Install shadcn/ui CLI with `npx shadcn@latest init` and configure with the specified settings: style 'new-york', RSC enabled, TypeScript support, Tailwind CSS v4 integration, and proper path aliases. The current project already has many shadcn/ui compatible dependencies like @radix-ui components, class-variance-authority, lucide-react, and tailwindcss-animate, so we need to ensure compatibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify CLI installation succeeds and generates components.json with correct configuration. Test that `npx shadcn@latest add button` works and integrates with existing components.

tasks.title: Migrate Existing Core Components
tasks.description: Replace existing custom UI components with latest shadcn/ui versions while maintaining functionality
tasks.details: The project already has Button, Input, Label, Radio Group, Form, and Sonner components in src/components/ui/. Replace each with the latest shadcn/ui versions using `npx shadcn@latest add [component]` for: button, input, label, radio-group, form. Ensure backward compatibility with existing authentication forms and pages that use these components.
tasks.testStrategy: Run existing authentication flows (signin/signup) to ensure no breaking changes. Verify all form validation continues to work with React Hook Form + Zod setup.

tasks.title: Add Essential Layout Components
tasks.description: Install and configure essential shadcn/ui components for improved layout and navigation
tasks.details: Add core layout and navigation components: card, sheet (for mobile navigation), tabs, separator, and navigation-menu. These will enhance the current authentication pages and provide foundation for future features. Configure theme support with next-themes integration that's already present.
tasks.testStrategy: Test responsive behavior on mobile/desktop. Verify dark/light theme switching works with new components. Test keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Form Components
tasks.description: Add sophisticated form components to enhance user input experience
tasks.details: Add select, checkbox, switch, textarea, and popover components. These will replace and enhance the existing custom form inputs like input-password.tsx and input-start-icon.tsx. Integrate with existing React Hook Form + Zod validation setup. Create custom input variants that include the icon functionality currently in use.
tasks.testStrategy: Test form validation and error states. Verify accessibility features including ARIA labels and keyboard navigation. Test form submissions and data handling.

tasks.title: Add Data Display and Management Components
tasks.description: Implement table, badge, avatar, and alert components for better data presentation
tasks.details: Add components for data visualization and user management: table (with sorting/filtering), badge (for status indicators), avatar (for user profiles), and alert (for important messages). These will support future dashboard and admin functionality. Ensure table component works well with existing Drizzle ORM data structures.
tasks.testStrategy: Test table rendering with various data sets. Verify badge color variants and accessibility. Test avatar fallback behavior. Check alert contrast and screen reader announcements.

tasks.title: Implement Interactive Components
tasks.description: Add interactive components for enhanced user engagement and feedback
tasks.details: Add dialog, dropdown-menu, tooltip, hover-card, and progress components. These will replace native browser dialogs and enhance user interactions. The dialog component will be particularly useful for confirmations and forms. Dropdown menu will improve navigation options. Progress bars will provide visual feedback for async operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test modal/layer stacking and focus management. Verify dropdown keyboard navigation. Test tooltip positioning and content. Check progress bar animation performance.

tasks.title: Configure Theme and Design System
tasks.description: Establish comprehensive theme system with brand colors and design tokens
tasks.details: Configure shadcn/ui theme system to work with existing next-themes setup. Define custom color palette that maintains brand identity while using shadcn/ui design tokens. Set up consistent spacing, typography, and border radius values. Ensure Tailwind CSS v4 configuration integrates properly with shadcn/ui CSS variables.
tasks.testStrategy: Test theme switching between light/dark modes. Verify color contrast meets WCAG AA standards. Test responsive design across different screen sizes.

tasks.title: Add Advanced Utility Components
tasks.description: Implement utility components for improved UX and development experience
tasks.details: Add accordion, collapsible, skeleton, and loading states. Accordion will help with FAQ or expandable content sections. Skeleton components will improve perceived performance during data loading. Collapsible will be useful for progressive disclosure. Also add command palette component for advanced search/quick actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test smooth animations and transitions. Verify keyboard navigation through accordion items. Test skeleton loading states during async operations. Check command palette search functionality.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization and Bundle Analysis
tasks.description: Optimize component bundle size and ensure performance targets are met
tasks.details: Implement lazy loading for heavy components using dynamic imports. Configure tree-shaking to ensure only used components are bundled. Set up bundle analysis to monitor size impact (<100KB increase target). Optimize Tailwind CSS purging for unused styles. Test Lighthouse scores to ensure >90 performance target is met.
tasks.testStrategy: Run bundle analysis before/after integration. Test Core Web Vitals with Lighthouse. Verify lazy loading behavior. Test application startup time and interactive performance.

tasks.title: Accessibility Testing and Documentation
tasks.description: Comprehensive accessibility testing and create component documentation
tasks.details: Perform WCAG 2.1 AA compliance testing on all new components using screen readers and keyboard navigation. Create interactive component documentation showing usage examples and customization options. Update existing authentication forms to demonstrate best practices. Document migration guide for team members.
tasks.testStrategy: Automated accessibility testing with axe-core. Manual testing with screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver). Keyboard-only navigation testing. Color contrast verification. Documentation review for accuracy and completeness.
